issues.issue: Water Fund receipts printed only as 'Local Receipts: Other'; treating them as charges is an assumption. If they are water sales, the user rule (2026-10-28) puts utility fund sales in Utility Charges, not charges for services/fees. user_rules.py will not catch this because the label has no sales/charges word and receipts carry no fund.
Same as the Water Fund line: an assumed category. Utility Charges if these are sewer charges (user rule 2026-10-28).
